## Verification

- [ ] Documentation and decision records reflect changed behavior.
- [ ] Large data and generated artifacts remain outside Git.
- [ ] New data/assets record source, license, checksum, coordinates, time, and processing provenance.
- [ ] Observation, forecast, scenario, and simulation values remain distinguishable.
